functions.name: Vrad3_LauncherMain
functions.note: CAppLaunchableDLL entry: command line, minidump options, -attach debugger switches, then Vrad3_Main

functions.name: Vrad3_Main
functions.note: banner, app systems (scenesystem SceneSystem_002/SceneUtils_001, vrad3 Vrad3_001), VRAD3_IN_PATH/VRAD3_OUT_PATH search paths, thread pool; each -name=value becomes script variable $name; -script runs through Vrad3_ExecuteScript; Total Time

functions.name: Vrad3_ExecuteScript
functions.note: the script file: routines (labels), $variables (unknown one: exit 1), run <label>; each line's tokens to Vrad3_RunCommand; second argument a start routine (Couldn't find routine)

functions.name: Vrad3_SetScriptVariable
functions.note: name ($name), value into the variable table

functions.name: Vrad3_RunCommand
functions.note: argv[0] looked up in the command table (DAT_180347d68, CUtlHashtable<CUtlString, CVrad3Command*>, 0x18-byte slots; hash FNV-1a 32 then h = (h << 17 ^ h) + (h >> 21)), then Run(argc, argv); unknown: Vrad3_ListCommands and exit 1

functions.name: VectorNormalize
functions.note: returns the length; 1e-17 to 1e17 guard, zero vector to zero, else the slow path 1801f51e0

functions.name: PackTangentFrame
functions.note: u32: bit 0 tangent sign (w >= 0), bits 1-11 the tangent's angle about the normal / 360 * 2047 (basis from the quantised normal, 1801f4060), bits 12-21 and 22-31 the octahedral normal (x, y) * 1023; third argument: a searched (precise) octahedral encode (1801f5300)

functions.name: std_Sort_32ByteElements
functions.note: introsort (threshold 32 elements, insertion sort below 0x40 bytes)

functions.name: CRenderContextPtr::CRenderContextPtr
functions.note: a render context from the device (vf 0x1e8)

functions.name: RenderResourceHandle_Release
functions.note: decrement +0x20, release through the resource system at zero

functions.name: RenderAttributes_SetInt
functions.note: inline map: 12 int slots keyed by MurmurHash2(lowercase name, 0x31415926)

functions.name: RenderAttributes_SetBuffer
functions.note: 4 buffer slots keyed by name hash

functions.name: RenderAttributes_SetTexture
functions.note: 8 texture slots keyed by name hash

functions.name: RenderAttributes_SetVec4
functions.note: 8 vec4 slots keyed by name hash

functions.name: Vrad3_GpuTimestamp
functions.note: a timestamp query on the context, appended with its stage index (the five block compute stages)

functions.name: CVrad3LightmapImage::SetPixelRGB
functions.note: the channel's bitmap (0x9d8-byte FloatBitMap_t per channel), components masked by its attribute mask

functions.name: PackingGeometry_t::Unserialize
functions.note: g_PackingGeometry (DAT_1803ab940): u32 n + n u32; u32 stride (40), u32 count + vertices (position, normal, tangent+sign); count x float2 atlas uv; u32 C + C indices; u32 D + D 28-byte charts (ARGB debug colour, index, x, y, w, h, flags word); C/3 u32 triangle charts; 6 u32 trailing fields; exact on probe01's file
